verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity-management platform, so custom vesting schedules are a fair question for it. However, no evidence item mentions vesting schedules, cliffs, milestone vesting, exit acceleration, or automatic tracking of vested versus unvested amounts. The evidence covers only scheme setup, option grants, option exercise, share issuance and cap tables, which are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically
